title: Quick Australian Meat Casserole
description: A sweet and crumbly one-pot dish that's perfect for a weeknight dinner. The addition of cayenne pepper gives it a nice kick.
instructions: Heat a large overproof casserole dish over medium-high heat. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and cook the minced beef until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the sliced onion and red bell pepper to the casserole dish and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the tomato paste, all-purpose flour, beef broth, red wine, honey, thyme, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the casserole dish. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then cover the casserole dish with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove the lid and continue baking for a further 10-15 minutes, or until the casserole is hot and the sauce is bubbly.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
